'''''Phaldera''''' was a group of three [[modular conveyor]]s that were part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force ''Vengeance'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Two of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] were carrying modulators, while the third one was carrying [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]]. The one with the warheads was destroyed by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] during their [[Mission to Almaran|recon mission]] of the Imperial fleet.
